folded.object: the companion of the fish when he called out while he was distressed

spans.text: [48] AR: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌۭ EN: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muhammad], and be not like the companion of the fish when he called out while he was distressed.

folded.id: because he|is|a possessor of wealth and children
folded.subject: Because he
folded.object: a possessor of wealth and children

spans.text: [14] AR: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍۢ وَبَنِينَ EN: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children,

folded.id: but it|is|not except a reminder to the worlds
folded.subject: But it
folded.object: not except a reminder to the worlds

spans.text: [52] AR: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ EN: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.
[2] AR: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍۢ EN: You are not, [O Muhammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.
By the pen and what they inscribe,

folded.id: came upon|the|garden an affliction from your lord while they were asleep
folded.subject: came upon
folded.object: garden an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep

spans.text: [19] AR: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ EN: So there came upon the garden an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.
[29] AR: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ EN: They said, "Exalted is our Lord!

[39] AR: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ EN: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?
[3] AR: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍۢ EN: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted.
[38] AR: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ EN: That indeed for you is whatever you choose?

[39] AR: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ EN: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?

folded.id: for|the|righteous with their lord are the gardens of pleasure
folded.subject: for
folded.object: righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure

spans.text: [34] AR: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ EN: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.

[48] AR: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌۭ EN: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muhammad], and be not like the companion of the fish when he called out while he was distressed.

[17] AR: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ EN: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning
[47] AR: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ EN: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

[51] AR: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ EN: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."

folded.id: his lord|chose|him and made him of the righteous
folded.subject: his Lord
folded.object: him and made him of the righteous

spans.text: [50] AR: فَٱجْتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ EN: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.

[49] AR: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌۭ EN: If not that a favor from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.
How do you judge?
[43] AR: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَٰلِمُونَ EN: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them.
[15] AR: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ EN: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
[28] AR: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ EN: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allah]?'
Indeed, My plan is firm.
[41] AR: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ EN: Or do they have partners?

folded.id: or|do|you ask of them a payment
folded.subject: Or
folded.object: you ask of them a payment

spans.text: [46] AR: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ EN: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

folded.id: or|do|you have a scripture in which you learn
folded.subject: Or
folded.object: you have a scripture in which you learn

spans.text: [37] AR: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَٰبٌۭ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ EN: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn

[39] AR: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ EN: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?

folded.id: our lord|will|substitute for us [one] better than it
folded.subject: our Lord
folded.object: substitute for us [one] better than it

spans.text: [32] AR: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ EN: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it.
[15] AR: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ EN: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
[46] AR: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ EN: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

folded.id: so you|will|see and they will see
folded.subject: So you

spans.text: [5] AR: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ EN: So you will see and they will see
[33] AR: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ EN: Such is the punishment [of this world].

folded.id: the day|the|shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but the disbelievers will not be able
folded.subject: The Day
folded.object: shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but the disbelievers will not be able

spans.text: [42] AR: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍۢ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ EN: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but the disbelievers will not be able,
[40] AR: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ EN: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible.
[8] AR: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ EN: Then do not obey the deniers.

folded.id: then|will|we treat the muslims like the criminals?
folded.subject: Then
folded.object: We treat the Muslims like the criminals?

spans.text: [35] AR: أَفَنَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ كَٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ EN: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?

folded.id: there|will|surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person
folded.subject: There
folded.object: surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person

spans.text: [24] AR: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌۭ EN: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."

[51] AR: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ EN: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."

folded.id: thrown onto|the|naked shore while he was censured
folded.subject: thrown onto
folded.object: naked shore while he was censured

spans.text: [49] AR: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌۭ EN: If not that a favor from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.
And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.

[17] AR: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ EN: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning
[26] AR: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ EN: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;
Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."
[16] AR: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْخُرْطُومِ EN: We will brand him upon the snout.

folded.id: we|will|progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know
folded.subject: We
folded.object: progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know

spans.text: We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.
[36] AR: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ EN: What is [the matter] with you?

folded.id: which|of|you is the afflicted [by a devil]
folded.subject: Which
folded.object: you is the afflicted [by a devil]

spans.text: [6] AR: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلْمَفْتُونُ EN: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil].
[44] AR: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ EN: So leave Me, [O Muhammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies the Qur'an.
[22] AR: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰرِمِينَ EN: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."
[4] AR: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍۢ EN: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.
[2] AR: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍۢ EN: You are not, [O Muhammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.

folded.id: your lord|is|most knowing of who has gone astray from his way
folded.subject: your Lord
folded.object: most knowing of who has gone astray from His way

spans.text: [7] AR: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ EN: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
